name: D.D.M. - Different Dimension Master
source_text: Discard 1 Spell Card from your hand. Special Summon 1 of your monsters that is currently removed from play. You can only activate this effect once per turn, during your Main Phase.
notes: Discarding a Spell is the cost; the banished monster returns in Attack Position.
